_comment: Calibration bridge file. Parameters of the line-movement process delta_p, generated by the Python research pipeline and consumed by the C# risk engine (RiskEngine.Core.CalibrationLoader). Regenerate with tools/export_calibration.py. Base values are the documented full-sample statistics; per-regime degrees-of-freedom are MLE fits and will be overwritten by the export script when run against the source data.
source: sports-derivatives Python pipeline - KDE / Bachelier / Student-t calibration on bookmaker-implied line movements (2.52M observations, 14 sports, 7 bookmakers, 2013-2024)

base.name: Full Sample
base.notes: Full-sample distribution of delta_p across all sports and bookmakers. Excess kurtosis 5.46 rejects normality decisively (Jarque-Bera p = 0).

regimes.name: Pre-PASPA
regimes.notes: Before the May 2018 PASPA repeal. Thinner liquidity, lower volatility, fattest tails.

regimes.name: Post-PASPA
regimes.notes: After the PASPA repeal, excluding the COVID window. Volatility up 36.5%, tails thinner - more participants, more efficient price discovery.

regimes.name: COVID
regimes.notes: 2020-2021 disrupted sporting calendar. Highest volatility, kurtosis closest to normal.
